task.title: Inserting Fields in a Template as a Section
task.shortdesc: You can insert fields as a section in your template and the inserted section will

context.p: You can insert fields as a section in your template and the inserted section will be added as a repeating section. This inserts each specified field on a new line when you select multiple fields (in the selected order).

step.cmd: Open a template in X-Author Contracts.
From the left navigation pane, select X-Author Templates.
Place the cursor in the section of the template text, where you want to insert a field and click Insert New Fields. This displays the Insert Fields window.
From the left column, select a line item object, such as Agreement Line Items.
In the window to the right, hold command and select one or more fields from the list.

note.p: Fields are inserted one below the other based on the order you select. Do not move your cursor when the fields are being inserted.

step.cmd: Select the checkbox Insert as a Section.
Click Submit. A repeat section is inserted into your template with each field displayed one below the other.

To search inserted fields:Navigate to the Template Fields tab. This displays the Repeat Section (object name) and the fields in the repeat section.Enter the field name in the search field and click the search icon ().

substep.cmd: Navigate to the Template Fields tab. This displays the Repeat Section (object name) and the fields in the repeat section.

step.cmd: To make an inserted field smart field or readonly:Click the gear icon () adjacent to the selected field name to open the Properties page.In the attributes list, turn on the Smart Field or Readonly switch based on your requirement and click Ok.
